title: chatId-contact mismatch rejection: no integration test through HTTP stack
description: The unit test deliver_chatid_sender_mismatch_returns_invalid_arguments (kith-peer/src/lib.rs) exercises the handler directly. No integration test in kithd/tests/ exercises the full HTTP → Caller extractor → _caller_identity → DeliverHandler path for this case. If the Caller extractor or identity propagation changes, the unit test still passes but the real rejection silently disappears. e2e.rs only covers senderUserId mismatch, not chatId-belongs-to-different-contact.
